name: Career Poster
niche: job advert multiposting for UK employers
business_model: per post (job board packages from £195 + VAT)
notes: UK multiposting service with a free hiring portal and package pricing. Applications go to the portal, email or the employer website. No API, language switcher or partner program found on the pages read.

review.note: Homepage states a Manchester address, per-advert package prices and manual submission; no API, language switcher or parent stated.
